rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing a person or expression that shows disdain for others.

example.english: They are always contemptuous, acting indifferent toward new colleagues.
example.traditional: 佢成日睇唔起人，對住新同事都係一副愛理不理嘅樣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 tai2 m4 hei2 jan4 deoi3 zyu6 san1 tung4 si6 dou1 hai6 jat1 fu3 oi3 lei5 bat1 lei5 ge3 joeng2

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when the contempt also comes across as cocky, insolent, or deliberately rude.

example.english: Don't be so contemptuous—you even sneer at people after they help you.
example.traditional: 你唔好咁串，人哋幫完你仲要寸返人。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 cyun3 jan4 dei6 bong1 jyun4 nei5 zung6 jiu3 cyun3 faan1 jan4

rows.note: Use this more formal adjective for an explicitly disdainful attitude, expression, or look.

example.english: The manager gave the cleaner a contemptuous look.
example.traditional: 經理用輕蔑嘅目光望住個清潔工。
example.jyutping: ging1 lei5 jung6 hing1 mit6 ge3 muk6 gwong1 mong6 zyu6 go3 cing1 git3 gung1
